correctness.rationale: The coherent-feature identity is exact on analytic vectors. Coherent finite-difference derivatives form a common quadratic-form core. Weyl shifts show negative eigen-directions of A or D make the quadratic oscillator unbounded below. Positive A,D have precisely the ground energy 2 tr sqrt(A^{1/2} D A^{1/2}), by a canonical scaling/orthogonal diagonalization, extended to singular matrices through monotone regularization. The resulting sharp spectral form bound is exactly 1-d_BW(A,D)^2/b. Seven thousand eight hundred fifty-five finite checks are consistent diagnostics but are not taken as proof.
